agenterm_dirty: clean at lane build; the only tree changes are this experiment's own research/ artifacts
target: native macOS aarch64 (host), profile default dev (cargo build --bin agenterm)

commands.capture: AGENTERM_REPLY_CAPTURE_DIR=... $BIN cli script run --profile tool --json --project-root scripts/qjs --timeout-ms <budget> --max-operations <budget> research/qjswasm-host-reply-wire-cost/capture/<journey>.capture.qjs -- . $BIN $BIN

anchor_note: the spec's section 5 command was written as `cli script run --profile tool --json -- <replies-dir> A|B|C`; this lane's binary exposes `--profile`, `--json`, `--timeout-ms`, `--max-operations`, `--project-root` and `-- ARGS...` (re-derived from `cli script run --help`), and the court takes SHAPES_DIR JOURNEY SHAPE. The extra `--project-root scripts/qjs` is required because a research/ entry resolves `lib/rh_compat` against the project root, and it changes no journey bytes.
